goal: Prevent depends builds from silently reusing package archives and building from the wrong source tree
Ensure distinct Git worktrees sharing a common source directory do not collide on package archives
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Code changes look right and match the fix proposed in the issue (ryanofsky)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it prevents silent build corruption when multiple checkouts share a source path
